notes.sowing: Start indoors 4 to 6 weeks before planting out, {cm:1.3} deep. Sprouts need a long season and should mature in cool fall weather: plant out around your last frost where summers are cool, or set transplants out 14 to 16 weeks before your first fall frost where summers are hot.
notes.care: Firm the soil well and stake tall plants in windy sites. Water through dry spells. Sprouts are best when they swell in cool weather, and frost improves the flavor.
notes.harvest: Pick from the bottom up once sprouts are about {cm:2.5} across and tight, snapping them off. Plants stand frost to about {c:-6}; after a hard freeze, cut the whole stalk.
